title: Збереження та перевірка копій
fields_and_relations: Failure domain, результат перевірок, відсутні/пошкоджені копії, restore history.
required_interaction: Прочитати копію, звірити SHA-256, налаштувати план, перевірити відновлення й повторно прочитати ціль; звіт/історія.

implementation.view_model: File plans, independent current byte proofs, manual locations, real copy reread, missing/corrupt issue, restore from reselected source with separate target check, portable report
limitations: 2 MiB per ingest/conversion; external storage is read via user-selected files, no remote writes or background scheduler.
Physical independence is declared by the responsible person; target restore requires a separate reread after download.
Canvas PNG thumbnails; other derived files imported from external tools. No audio/video transcoding or streaming server.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store v9; existing files, revisions and historical checks preserved
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
implementation.preservation: WF-13: actual bytes and SHA-256/size; filename/path occurrences; immutable file identity; exact representation derivation; proof-based independent copy policy and due dates; append-only fixity/recovery and targeted issue resolution.
